source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Arrange the maintenance records chronologically.
3. Use pictures and annotations to illustrate your discussion.
(a) High-resolution photographs
(b) Align plans and elevations to help identify structural members.
(c) Mark the direction of the view clearly.
4. Prepare a short but clear description of the structure.
(a) Identify the main components of the structure.
(b) Show the condition of each component.
(c) Briefly describe the general causes and consequences of each defect.
(d) Identify the potential ramifications of ignoring this defect.
(e) Include a proposed budgetary estimate of the resources for the repair.
5. Discuss the long-term consequences.
(a) Propose an alternative repair method that offers long-term structural viability.
(b) The alternatives must compare previous and long-term outcomes, with and without repair.
(c) Identify external factors that increase risk.
